_convention.module_xy: x,y from the PCB's bottom-left corner, top view. Top view = looking at the face that points up out of the panel (display / key / shaft side). x to the right, y up. Each module's notes say which edge is 'top' (y = h).
_convention.bare_parts: For parts without a PCB (sensors, switches, servo, panel hardware) 'pcb' is the body bounding box in the same top view and 't' is the body height along z.
_convention.holes: Mounting holes only (centre x, y and diameter d). Pin/lead positions are in 'headers' or 'pins'.
_convention.window: Rectangle the plate cut-out must expose (x, y = its bottom-left corner in module coords, w, h). null if none.
_convention.panel_hole: Round hole the part needs in a plate or the case wall. null if none.
_convention.heights: height_above_pcb / height_below_pcb are measured from the PCB top / bottom faces (for bare parts: from the seating plane). Panel hardware (posts, key switch, USB-C) uses above / below the panel face instead; see notes.
_convention.case_z: Case z = 0 at the interior floor of the base, z up. Panel z_from_floor is the panel's underside; z_top is its top face.
_convention.status: verified = read off a dimensioned drawing or datasheet; typical = common value inferred from photos, listings or several clones. 'verified_fields' lists which fields are verified when a module mixes both.

case.name: Pelican 1520 Protector Case (1520NF, empty) + Pelican 1520PF panel frame kit

interior.corner_r_status: assumption: equals the 1520PF frame's outer corner radius (R16.5 verified); the bare wall radius is not published
interior.floor_status: assumption: about 1 deg wall draft plus floor fillets (Nanuk 930 drawing shows ~2.2 mm per side over the base depth). Measure before sizing a floor sled.

panel_frame.name: Pelican 1520PF special application panel frame (drawing 1523-314-000 rev A)
panel_frame.insert_thread: not published for 1520PF; Case Club Q&A gives #6-32 x 1/4 in for the 1300PF inserts (typical, check on arrival)
panel_frame.kit: 1 frame, 1 O-ring, 16 threaded brass inserts, 4 self-tapping screws (frame to case wall)

panel.material: 3 mm laser-cut acrylic or birch ply (non-metal keeps the DevKit PCB antenna and PN532 usable)
panel.support: Pelican 1520PF panel frame: frame sits inside the base rim on its O-ring, held by 4 self-tapping screws into the wall; the panel screws onto the frame's 16 brass inserts and its top sits flush with the base rim.
panel.outline_status: derived: frame outer outline minus ~1.3 mm per side; test-fit against the frame
panel.screw_holes_frame: panel coords, origin = panel bottom-left, panel centred on the frame (frame centre = 226.0, 160.5)

clear_zone.note: frame inner opening; every plate opening and every hanging module must stay inside this

depth_budget.what: floor sled (3 mm ply/printed plate, held by VHB or foam wedges; floor not drilled)
DevKit PCB 1.6 + WROOM-32E module 3.1 (highest carrier part)
JST-XH vertical headers + mated housings + wire bend radius
modules hanging below the plates (40 mm below plate underside at 125.2)
panel 3 mm, top flush with base rim
module plates 3 mm on top of the panel
knobs, binding posts, antenna above plates (keep <= 35 mm)

alternatives.name: Harbor Freight Apache 4800
alternatives.status: verified (L/W/total only; lid/base split not published)

devkitc_32e.name: Espressif ESP32-DevKitC-32E (DevKitC V4 board, 38 pin)
devkitc_32e.notes: USB edge at y = 0, module antenna at top and overhanging the PCB by 6.04 mm (total length 54.30). Drawing gives 1.30 mm pin-to-edge on one side (rounded); 1.27 assumed symmetric. Rows are 25.40 mm apart (verified). Narrow 38-pin clones (NodeMCU-32S style) use 22.86 mm (0.9 in) rows and ~25.5 x 52 mm boards: they will not fit a 25.4 mm footprint. Heights: module 3.1 mm on top; pre-soldered male headers 2.5 plastic + ~6 mm pins below (typical). PCB thickness typical.

gy521.name: GY-521 MPU-6050 breakout

rows.order_top_to_bottom: VCC GND SCL SDA XDA XCL AD0 INT

gy521.notes: Header on the left edge (VCC at top), two holes on the right edge. Hole centres scaled from the Components101 layout image. Clones range 20.3-21.2 x 15.6-16.4 mm. Plugs into a 1x8 female header on the carrier (sits on the carrier, not a plate).

mcp23017_dip28.name: Microchip MCP23017-E/SP, 28-lead skinny PDIP (300 mil)
mcp23017_dip28.notes: Body outline E1 x D = 7.24 x 34.67 (nominal), seated height max 5.08. On the carrier in a 28-pin 0.3 in socket (typical socket body ~35.6 x 10.1 x 4.3 mm; adds ~4.3 mm).

ky040.name: KY-040 rotary encoder module (EC11-type encoder with push switch)

rows.type: right-angle, pins point +x ~6 mm past the edge

ky040.notes: Mount by the encoder bushing: 7.5 mm plate hole, M7 nut (~10 mm AF, ~2 mm thick) on top; with a 3 mm plate the encoder body top must sit <= ~2 mm under the plate. PCB hole positions are scaled from an illustration and one seller gives 13.75 mm hole pitch: treat as unreliable and measure. Shaft length 15 or 20 mm variants exist (20 mm assumed). Encoder centre position typical.

tm1637_056.name: TM1637 4-digit 0.56 in 7-segment module (colon, 4 corner holes, 4-pin headers at both ends)
tm1637_056.notes: Outline measured by lygte-info (66.1 x 27.1). Hole centres, header positions and display position scaled from a product photo; display body 50.4 x 19.0 x 8.0 is the usual 0.56 in 4-digit size. A smaller 0.36 in module (42.0 x 24.1, holes 2.2 at 38.0 x 20.3) is a different part: do not mix.

ssd1306_096.name: SSD1306 0.96 in 128x64 I2C OLED module (4 pin)
ssd1306_096.notes: Header edge = top. Window is the panel's viewing area (VA 23.74 x 12.86); its vertical position is estimated (+-1.5 mm): cut the plate window 2 mm taller and test-fit. Outline/holes from the Components101 drawing (7-pin SPI board, same PCB); 4-pin boards measure 27-27.5 x 27-27.8 with M2-M3 holes, so check the received batch. Pins usually pre-soldered pointing back.

sh1106_13.name: SH1106 1.3 in 128x64 I2C OLED module (4 pin)

rows.order_left_to_right: VDD GND SCK SDA (varies by seller)

sh1106_13.notes: Header edge = top. Outline, hole centres (2.0 from sides, 3.0 from top, 2.0 from bottom) and header position from the ETT dimension drawing; hole diameter and window position scaled from it. Other sellers list hole spacing 30.5 x 29 (Keyestudio) or 30 x 28 (Audiophonics): measure before drilling.

pn532_v3.name: Elechouse PN532 NFC RFID module V3 (red)

rows.order_left_to_right: SCK MISO MOSI SS VCC GND IRQ RSTO

pn532_v3.notes: Silkscreen side = top view, SPI header edge = top. Antenna is the white band round the perimeter (~4 mm wide): mount antenna-up under a non-metal plate <= 3 mm, no metal screws or standoffs over the band. Hole centres and header positions scaled from the Elechouse photo; hole d 3 mm from a reseller. Comes with right-angle pins.

keypad_4x4_hard.name: 4x4 hard-key matrix keypad (black ABS frame, 16 plastic keys, 10-pad PCB tail)

rows.order_left_to_right: NC C1 C2 C3 C4 R1 R2 R3 R4 NC
rows.type: pads on a PCB tail ~44 x 4 mm below the frame's bottom edge

keypad_4x4_hard.notes: 'pcb' here is the plastic frame (66 x 68.6 x 10 overall); the tail with the 10 pads hangs off the bottom edge (y < 0). Mount from below: raised key field through a 60 x 60 cut-out (corners need ~R6 to clear the 61 mm-square holes). Legends are phone-style (1-9, 0, A-D, *, #), not 0-F: needs a label/overlay per SPEC. Key pitch and hole diameter typical (scaled from AZ-Delivery pinout drawing). Hole spacing 61 mm and the 60 x 60 cut-out are from AZ-Delivery and Vetco.

vs1838b.name: VS1838B 38 kHz IR receiver (bare 3-lead part)
vs1838b.notes: Top view = lens face up (6.1 x 7.1 face, 5.1 deep incl. dome). Mount lens-up behind a 6.5 x 7.5 window or lens-forward through the plate; leads bent 90 deg and wired to the harness. A KY-022 style module board (~18.5 x 15 mm) is an alternative.

gl5528.name: GL5528 5 mm CdS photoresistor (LDR)
gl5528.notes: Dia 5.1 body with flats 4.3 apart, 2.1 thick, leads 3.0 mm apart (TruOpto); JCHL parts use 3.4 mm. Press-fit into a 5.4 mm plate hole, face up. Panel hole size is a proposal.

tact_12mm.name: 12 x 12 mm through-hole tactile switch, 7.3 mm actuator (e.g. Same Sky TS13-1212-73)
tact_12mm.notes: Snap-on caps (A24 type) raise the total to ~12 mm above the PCB. The plate opening depends on the cap chosen (translucent caps with WS2812 under them per SPEC): not fixed here.

buzzer_12mm.name: 12 mm passive (magnetic/piezo) buzzer, PCB pins
buzzer_12mm.notes: Dia 12 x 8.5-9.5 mm; pin pitch 7.6 (some 6.5). A 3 mm sound hole over the buzzer port is a proposal.

ws2812b.name: WS2812B addressable LED, 5050 package
ws2812b.notes: Plates will use breakouts rather than bare LEDs: 60 LED/m strip pieces are 10 mm wide at 16.67 mm pitch; single round breakouts ~10 mm dia; 5 mm through-hole WS2812D-F5 is dia 5 x 8.6. Light hole size is a proposal.

sg90.name: TowerPro SG90 9 g micro servo
sg90.notes: Top view = output shaft up; 'pcb' = mounting flange. Heights are from the flange underside: 16 below, 15 up to the top of the output spline (horn adds ~4). Ear hole spacing 27.5 / dia 2 and shaft offset (~6 mm from the body end) are typical, not on the drawing.

banana_post_4mm.name: 4 mm banana binding post, panel mount (Cliff TP6 class)
banana_post_4mm.notes: Heights are above / below the plate face. Panel hole 7 mm for Cliff TP6 posts; cheap M4/M6 posts need 4.5-8 mm, so drill to the bought part. Height above panel ~30 mm and max panel 7 mm (RS PRO 4 mm post). Keep >= 19.05 mm (0.75 in) centres so dual plugs fit; 12 posts at 19.05-25 mm pitch fit a 2 x 6 grid ~130 x 40 mm. Leads must be unplugged to close the lid (posts + plugs exceed the 45 mm lid).

key_switch_19mm.name: 19 mm keylock switch, 2-position ON/OFF (case wall)
key_switch_19mm.notes: Heights are outside / inside the wall face. Bezel/washer dia ~28, body dia ~22 x 39 mm, up to 51 mm incl. solder tabs; max wall 16-19 mm. Some models need a D-cut (Alcoswitch 19.3 x 16.3). Keep the 51 mm inside the wall clear of the carrier and below the panel (wall zone z 40-100).

usbc_panel.name: Panel-mount USB-C 5 V input: Adafruit 4218 round USB-C extension (option A)
usbc_panel.notes: Heights are outside / inside the wall face; inside depth (body + plug + cable bend) is an estimate. Needs a USB-C power breakout or pigtail inside to reach J_PWR. Option B: ear-mount USB-C socket cable (Adafruit 4053/4056 style) with two M3 screws 20 mm apart, wall <= 6.35 mm. Choice is open.

soic8_breakout.name: SOIC-8 to DIP-8 adapter board (W25Q32)
soic8_breakout.notes: Generic adapter sizes vary (10-15 mm). Pins on a DIP-8 grid.

dip8_socket.name: DIP-8 IC socket, 0.3 in (24C32 EEPROM)
dip8_socket.notes: Standard 0.3 in socket; DIP-8 EEPROM adds ~3.3 mm on top.

header_254.name: 2.54 mm pin headers (probe plate) and female headers (carrier)
header_254.notes: Per pin. Male: 2.5 plastic + ~6 mm mating pin above, ~3 mm tail below. Female: 8.5 mm tall body.

rpsma_bulkhead.name: RP-SMA bulkhead + U.FL pigtail (optional, DevKitC-32UE variant)
rpsma_bulkhead.notes: 1/4-36 UNS thread. Standard 2.4 GHz rubber ducks (~110 mm) do not fit under the 45 mm lid: use a stubby (< 35 mm) or a fold-down articulated antenna.
